cues.en: Alright, so first of all, apologies to any Windows devs. Firstly, this is probably not going to be very interesting to you guys. And secondly, well just, I'm sorry for you. But maybe you'll come across. So we're going to show a couple of things in GDB that I've found over the years. So we deal a lot with, so we make this
cues.zh: 好，首先，向所有 Windows 开发者说声抱歉。第一，这些内容对你们可能不太有意思。第二，呃，我只能说为你们感到遗憾。不过也许你们会碰到。接下来我会展示几个我这些年发现的 GDB 技巧。我们经常打交道，呃，我们做一个

cues.en: this tool called UndoDB, which is, well, the most common interface to it, probably, is GDB. So a lot of our customers spend their time in GDB, and we work with them, and sometimes, often, it's more they're looking at how to do something in GDB, and I've kind of picked up some good stuff over the years that I thought it might be interesting to share. So, probably, so yeah, so I just want to start by...
cues.zh: 叫 UndoDB 的工具。它最常见的接口大概就是 GDB。我们的很多客户都把时间花在 GDB 上，我们和他们一起工作，很多时候更像是他们在研究怎么在 GDB 里做某件事，而我这些年也积累了一些好东西，觉得分享出来可能挺有意思。所以，大概，呃，我就想先

cues.en: by saying, so I would be the first person to admit that GDB is not intuitive, right? But it is very powerful. And I think there's an important distinction to make between ease of use and ease of learning. And it's not easy to learn, but it is easy to use when you get to learn it. And it's not that hard to learn, right? Sometimes you just need to know that these things exist. So here's a...
cues.zh: 说一句：我会第一个承认，GDB 并不直观，对吧？但它非常强大。我认为要区分“易用”和“易学”，这一点很重要。它不容易学，但一旦学会了就很好用。而且它也没那么难学，对吧？有时候你只需要知道这些东西存在。所以这里有个……

cues.en: It's a pretty simple program, not much more than Hello World, but it's got a few lines, so I can at least type next a few times. And I compile just as normal, and I run this in GDB, right, and most of us, many of us would have done this at some point. And you can start, which just saves you typing break at main and then run. And it's like, okay, I'm at line six of my program, but I don't have any context, right? And, well, I can get a list.
cues.zh: 很简单的程序，差不多就是 Hello World，但好歹有几行，我至少能多按几次 next。我就正常编译，然后在 GDB 里运行，对吧，我们大多数人、很多人某个时候都这么干过。你可以用 start，这样就省得敲 break at main 再 run。然后就像，好吧，我停在程序第 6 行，但我没有任何上下文，对吧？不过，我可以 list 一下源码。

cues.en: so that's kind of okay. But what I want to show you is probably the thing that I think is probably least known and most useful, like the thing that scores best on both ranks, which is this thing called TUI mode, which stands for Text User Interface, and it's a really bad name, because surely that is a text user interface, right? And it's a bit, well, 1970s, and it's just kind of clunky.
cues.zh: 所以这还凑合。但我想给你看的，大概是我认为最不为人知、又最有用的东西，就是在这两项上都得分最高的功能：TUI 模式，全称 Text User Interface，这名字真不怎么样，因为刚才那个明明也是文本用户界面，对吧？而且它有点，呃，上世纪 70 年代的感觉，还有点笨重。

cues.en: But if you type, and I don't know why you have to type this, and why it's so obscure, but if you type control x a, then you get the real TUI text user interface, which is like screaming into the 1980s, but it is still pretty useful. So now when I type next, I get much more context of what my program is doing. It's not perfect, like all curses programs, it sometimes goes a bit weird sometimes. So if I type next again,
cues.zh: 但如果你按，我不知道为什么非得按这个，也不知道为什么这么隐蔽，但如果你按 Ctrl-X A，就会得到真正的 TUI 文本用户界面，那感觉很像 1980 年代，不过还是挺有用的。所以现在当我按 next，我能看到程序在做什么的更多上下文。它并不完美，像所有 curses 程序一样，有时会有点怪。所以如果我再按一次 next，

cues.en: my program's printed out Hello World, and it's kind of screwed up my display, and that's a reliable way to make it go wrong. There are more interesting ways it goes wrong, but none of them I could find that were reliable. But if it does, you can just do control L, and it repaints the screen for you, so it's quite handy. And you can actually do a bit more, so you can, if I go control X2, I may not have enough characters for this, but no.
cues.zh: 我的程序打印出了 Hello World，然后显示就有点乱了，这是让它出错的可靠方法。还有更有趣的出错方式，但我找不到哪种能稳定复现。不过如果真乱了，你只要按 Ctrl-L，它就会帮你重绘屏幕，所以挺方便的。其实你还能多做一点，比如，如果我按 Ctrl-X 2，我这里的字符可能不够展示这个，不过没事。

cues.en: Let me make this slightly smaller so that I can, I was all perfectly set up for this before my system reset. So where were we, so here, okay so, and then you go control X2, control X2, I get multiple windows. And so here obviously I've got my source code with my assembly, and if I go control X2 again, it will cycle through and then I can get my registers as well.
cues.zh: 我先把这个缩小一点，系统重启前我都准备得好好的。说到哪了，这里，好，然后按 Ctrl+X 2，再按 Ctrl+X 2，就能分出多个窗口。显然这里是我的源码和汇编，如果我再按一次 Ctrl+X 2，它会循环切换，这样就能看到寄存器了。

cues.en: and you can change what you're seeing. So I can go to UI reg, that's the general purpose registers, but if I go to UI reg float and it will show me the floating registers. So you can sort of set things up so it just makes it much more convenient. You don't have to spend all that time looking through and flipping back and forth. I'm gonna control X1, I'll go back and let's go control X1 and we go back to our source code.
cues.zh: 你还可以切换显示内容。比如输入 tui reg，这是通用寄存器，如果输入 tui reg float，就会显示浮点寄存器。所以你可以根据需要配置，用起来方便得多。就不用浪费时间来回翻找了。按 Ctrl+X 1 回去，再按一次 Ctrl+X 1，就回到了源码视图。

cues.en: And the other thing you'll find that you can do in this mode is by doing up arrow here, and it goes up and down, which actually is really annoying. Because what certainly I do a lot of the time is you go up arrow in order to get the previous command, right? And now you can't do that anymore. But turns out, I only found this out really recently, you can go control P, and then I can get.
cues.zh: 在这个模式下你还会发现，按上下箭头会滚动代码，这其实挺让人烦躁的。因为平时我们经常习惯按上箭头来调出上一条命令，对吧？但在这种模式下就不行了。不过我最近才发现，其实可以按 Ctrl+P，这样就能调出……

cues.en: my previous commands. So control P and N into UI mode goes up and down my command history. I think you can do control P and N normally in CLI mode, but certainly I would just normally use up and down there. Yeah. Ah yeah, so you should just be able to press J and K and then it would be all right. I don't know what's wrong with the world.
cues.zh: 之前的历史命令。在 TUI 模式下按 Ctrl+P 和 N 可以上下翻阅历史命令。平时在 CLI 模式下应该也可以按 Ctrl+P 和 N，不过那时候我通常直接用上下箭头。对，要能直接按 j 和 k 就好了。真不知道这帮人怎么想的。

cues.en: So there you go. So that's TUI. I don't really have the kind of racing through now. The other thing I think the second probably most useful thing to, I think a lot of people know about now, but still not everybody, is there's a Python interpreter built into the GDB. Anything since version seven. And so this is very, very powerful, right? So I can do, just type Python, and then.
cues.zh: 差不多就是这样。这就是 TUI。我现在得赶一下进度。第二件我觉得大概最实用的功能——可能很多人已经知道了，但并不是所有人都知道——就是 GDB 内置了一个 Python 解释器。从 7.0 版本开始就有了。这个功能非常非常强大，对吧？我只需要输入 python，然后……

cues.en: I don't know, so you can do print, hello world. Oh, at least if I can type, and the Python works, all right. Now if I go, I'm gonna come out of TUIMO, because it's sometimes a bit clearer. So I can type multiple lines of Python, and you can do, it's pretty much a full Python interpreter, at least as long as your GDB build isn't messed up, which sometimes, we encounter quite a lot actually, but import OS, and then,
cues.zh: 比如输入 print('hello world')。呃，只要我别打错字，你看 Python 跑起来了。现在我先退出 TUI 模式，因为有时普通模式看起来更清晰。我可以输入多行 Python，这几乎就是一个完整的 Python 解释器，只要你编译的 GDB 没问题——虽然有时候经常遇到编译出问题的情况——但输入 import os，然后……

cues.en: I can print, I don't know, mypid is, right? So you can do anything that you want to do in Python, and actually you can define functions that you can then call from the command line, and you can even define functions that then you can make become sort of first-class GDB commands, which is kind of cool. And it's not just that there's this Python interpreter sort of sitting there that you can just do stuff, it's really,
cues.zh: 我可以打印出当前 PID，对吧？你在 Python 里能做的事这里全都能做，你甚至可以定义函数然后在命令行里调用，甚至能把函数注册成原生的 GDB 命令，这非常酷。而且它不仅是内置了一个供你调用的 Python 解释器，它还与……

cues.en: tightly bound to GDB itself. So for example, let's put a couple of breakpoints in. So switch back to there. So if I break at main and, I don't know, I'll break at line nine as well. So if I, in Python, I can go, let's print gdb.breakpoints and...
cues.zh: GDB 本身深度绑定。举个例子，我们加几个断点。切换回那边。比如在 main 下个断点，再在第 9 行也下个断点。然后用 Python，我们可以打印 gdb.breakpoints，接着……

cues.en: that gives me a list of these breakpoint objects, right? And they contain all the kind of things that you'd want. So I could do breakpoints, take the zeroth one, and I don't know, just show the location, okay? And so you can find out information about those breakpoints, and you get all the normal things enabled, whether they're enabled, and there's advanced things set. And you can even set breakpoints from the Python. So you can go
cues.zh: 这会返回一个断点对象列表，对吧？里面包含你想要的所有内容。比如我可以取第 0 个断点，查看它的位置。这样你就能获取这些断点的信息，查看是否启用等常规属性，还有一些高级设置。你甚至可以在 Python 中设置断点。你可以这样写：

cues.en: Let's try and get this right. I just need to create a breakpoint object and I give it a location specifier, so let's put one on line seven. And now that breakpoint's appeared. And you can see the breakpoints on the left here. So by using these kind of things, and you can find out information about what the source file is and you can look up all your local variables. And one of the very cool things you can do that I don't have time to show now.
cues.zh: 我们来试一下。我只需要创建一个断点对象并指定位置，比如打在第 7 行。现在断点就出现了，左边可以看到它。利用这些功能，你可以查看源文件信息，查看所有局部变量。还有一个很酷的功能，我现在没时间细讲了，

cues.en: is that you can do Python pretty printers, right? So if you've got these structures that you've made and you just, when you type print my structure, you want it to look nice, you can do that in whatever way that you want. Another really, I think, quite useful thing is, well, I'm a bit biased here, but.
cues.zh: 就是你可以写 Python pretty printer（美化输出器）。如果你自己定义了结构体，想在打印时让它更好看，完全可以按自己的想法来做。另一个我认为非常实用的功能是——虽然我可能有点王婆卖瓜——

cues.en: reversible debugging. Now GDB has inbuilt reversible debugging, so you don't need to be a customer of ours to take advantage of this. Our stuff is much quicker and generally much more awesome, but still you have reversible debugging in GDB that works quite well. So here I have a program that is just, it's a bubble sort, right? Very simple, doesn't really do anything, it just fills an array with randomized data and then it sorts it. So it doesn't even print anything out.
cues.zh: 可逆调试。GDB 内置了可逆调试功能，所以即便不是我们的客户也能使用。我们的工具当然快得多，总体上也强大得多，但 GDB 自带的可逆调试其实也相当好用。这里我有一个冒泡排序程序，非常简单，什么也没干，只是用随机数据填充数组然后排序，甚至都不打印任何输出。

cues.en: But I happen to know that there's a bug in there that doesn't quite go every time. So if I run that in a loop, it usually works. And this is the peril of intermittent bugs when you're waiting for them. But there we go. Every so often, it sucks these. And okay, it's made a core dump, so that's useful. So there it is. So I can load that up. So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 但我碰巧知道里面有个偶现的 bug。如果循环运行它，大部分时候是正常的。这就是偶现 bug 最让人头疼的地方，你得干等着它复现。不过瞧，来了，它偶尔就会崩掉。好了，它生成了 core dump，这很有用。文件就在这，我可以加载它。我们来看一下。

cues.en: This is what we usually do with a core dump. But we've got no stack information at all. So clearly this is some kind of stack smashing bug and the core files have no use. So what I'm going to do instead, that runs no good now, that information's all gone. But if instead I start gdb like this and I'm going to, actually I'm gonna put a,
cues.zh: 平时分析 core dump 就是这么做的。但这里完全没有栈信息。显然这是某种破坏调用栈（stack smashing）的 bug，core 文件根本派不上用场。所以我打算换个做法，刚才那次没用了，信息全没了。但如果我像这样启动 gdb，然后准备……其实我要加一个……

cues.en: What I want to do is enable reversible debugging so that when it faults, I can step back a bit, and then I can get the context. I don't need the backtrace. But I need to run it a bunch of times as well, and obviously it's kind of tedious to do that by hand. But you can set breakpoints, and you can have commands that issue when those breakpoints are hit. So if I set a breakpoint on main, and I set another breakpoint on,
cues.zh: 我想做的是开启可逆调试，这样当程序崩溃报错时，我可以往后退几步，从而拿到当时的上下文，都不需要栈回溯了。但我还得让它多跑几次，手动来做显然太麻烦了。不过你可以设置断点，并在断点命中时自动执行命令。所以如果我在 main 处打个断点，再在……

cues.en: I happen to know, this is a bit of a hack, but I happen to know that there's this, when it exits, normally it goes through this line. Actually, I probably could just do it on the last line of main. Anyway, that'll do. And I'm gonna apply commands to run when these breakpoints are hit. So when breakpoint three is hit, I just want to rerun. And when breakpoint two is hit, which is the one at main, sorry, the command.
cues.zh: 我碰巧知道——虽然有点投机取巧——程序正常退出时会走这一行。其实直接打在 main 的最后一行也行。总之这样就可以了。接着我要给这些断点添加命中时执行的命令。当断点 3 命中时，就直接重新运行。当断点 2（也就是 main 处的断点）命中时，不好意思，命令是……

cues.en: I want to enable recording and continue. And now, oh, hang on, before I do that, I want to set pagination off, because that will get annoying. And now, when I rerun, what it's doing is every time it hits the top break point at main, it's going to turn on recording and run through, and then when it gets to the end, it's going to just start again. And once again, we have this kind of indeterminate weight, because this is a
cues.zh: 我想开启录制并继续运行。现在，噢等等，在此之前我想先关闭分页（set pagination off），不然会很烦人。现在当我重新运行，它的行为是每次命中 main 顶部的断点时，就开启录制并一直跑到底，一旦结束就又重新开始。于是我们又得经历这种不确定的等待，因为这是个

cues.en: an intermittent bug, but if we're patient enough, eventually it doesn't get to the end. It's stopped in hyperspace, and I can start to look around at what's going on. So I can look at my program counter. Okay, so if I do X to look at the memory there, we can't access that memory. I appear to have jumped into hyperspace, as we saw before, backtrace is kind of garbage, but I can reverse step I.
cues.zh: 偶发性 bug，但只要足够有耐心，它最终会卡住而没跑到头。它停在了未知区域（hyperspace），我就可以开始查看发生了什么。来看看程序计数器（PC）。好，如果我用 x 命令查看那里的内存，发现无法访问。看来我确实跳进了未知区域，就像之前看到的那样，调用栈回溯（backtrace）也乱成一团，但我可以反向单步执行（reverse stepi）。

cues.en: which is like step I, but just gonna go back one instruction. And suddenly, ta-da, we're back in sensible land. Now I have a stack that works. And if you look here, I'm at the end. So what's going on? Well, I can look at the disassembly of the code, and I can see this little arrow at the bottom tells me that I'm trying to issue a return instruction. So not that surprising as we think we've got some kind of stack corruption. Well, let's have a look at what's going on there. So if I look at the stack pointer,
cues.zh: 它类似于 stepi，但只是倒退一条指令。突然，噔噔！我们回到了正常世界。现在调用栈正常了。大家看这里，我已经到了函数末尾。那么发生了什么？我可以看看代码的反汇编，底部的小箭头提示我正试图执行一条 return 指令。既然我们怀疑发生了栈损坏，这倒不令人意外。那我们来看看究竟是怎么回事。看一下栈指针，

cues.en: The stack point is that, so return on x86 at least will return to the top of the stack. And if I look at the top of the stack, sure enough, that is the bogus address that we were jumping to. So someone's clearly written rubbish on top of my stack, so how do I know what that is? Well, if I watch that, watch point, so sometimes called data break point,
cues.zh: 栈指针是这个，在 x86 上执行 return 至少会返回到栈顶保存的地址。而查看栈顶，果不其然，就是我们刚才跳过去的那个非法地址。显然有人把垃圾数据写到了栈顶，那怎么知道是谁写的？如果我监视它，设个观察点（watchpoint），有时也叫数据断点，

cues.en: And the idea is you set these watch points, and usually what you do is you run forwards until the data is changed. What this is gonna do is run backwards until that location in memory changes, which is gonna be who's written to my stack, which ought to have been when I entered the function. But we suspect, from what we've seen, it's not. And I'm going to reverse continue. And so now, I've gone back in time to when that stack was modified, and perhaps slightly unsurprisingly, it's when I'm writing into my array.
cues.zh: 原理就是设置这类观察点，通常的做法是正向运行直到数据改变。而这里要做的是反向倒退，直到该内存位置发生改变，也就是找到是谁写了我的栈——正常应该是在进入函数时写入的。但从目前来看，显然不是。我现在执行反向继续运行（reverse continue）。现在，我回退到了栈被修改的那一刻，不出所料，正是我往数组里写入的时候。

cues.en: and let's have a look, what's I at that time? So I have full data at this point, and I can see I is 35, and if I do my very annoying up arrow, we'll see that the array is only 32 elements long, and of course the bug is that we've got this, we're using percent size of array when we should have used, you know, that's the number of bytes in the array, not the number of elements. So there was three very quick things. There's loads and loads of other stuff.
cues.zh: 我们来看看，当时的 i 是多少？此时我有完整的数据，能看到 i 是 35。按一下烦人的向上箭头键，可以看到数组只有 32 个元素，显然 bug 就在这里，我们用了 sizeof 数组，而那是数组的字节数，并不是元素个数。这就是非常快速讲完的三个技巧。除此之外还有非常多的内容。

cues.en: I've just ignored my slides, but there's loads of cool stuff. I'm gonna do a longer open content session tomorrow. Well, I still won't have time to go into all of this, but I'll go into more of it and some other cool stuff as well. So thank you for your attention.
cues.zh: 我刚才完全没讲我的幻灯片，不过里面有很多很酷的内容。明天我会做一场更长的开放内容环节。嗯，我还是没时间把这些都讲到，但我会多讲一些，也会讲些别的酷东西。谢谢大家。
